name: coachcompass
description: Find professional coaches in the CoachCompass directory: search by need, location and budget; read profiles, prices and availability; learn about coaching.

interface.longDescription:
Find a professional coach without leaving the chat. CoachCompass is a directory of more than 1,000 coaches for business, leadership, careers, life and wellbeing, mostly in Sweden, France, the United Kingdom and Denmark.

Describe what you need help with, where you are and your budget, and CoachCompass shows matching coaches as cards with photo, title, location, hourly price and specialties. Open any coach to read their full profile, services and prices, see open booking times when the coach books through CoachCompass, and jump to coachcompass.co to get in touch or book. You can also ask general questions about coaching and get answers from CoachCompass articles and FAQs.

The app is read-only and needs no account: it never books, pays or contacts anyone on your behalf, and it only shows information coaches have chosen to publish.
capabilities: Search coaches by need, location and budget
Show coach profiles, services and prices
Answer questions about coaching with articles

positive.description: Search by need and location; results render as coach cards with profile links.
positive.prompt: I'm a new manager in Stockholm and I'm struggling to lead my team. Can you find me a leadership coach?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows coach cards for business/leadership coaches in Stockholm or Sweden, each with name, title, location and a View profile button linking to https://coachcompass.co/coach/<slug>.

positive.description: Open one coach's full profile with services and prices.
positive.prompt: Show me the full profile for the coach with slug navid-zargham.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one detailed coach card with bio, specialties, languages and hourly price (SEK 180/h), plus a link to the profile.

positive.description: Budget filter in the coach's own currency.
positive.prompt: Find life coaches in Sweden that cost at most 200 per hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_coaches with category=life, country=Sweden, max_hourly_rate=200 and shows only coaches with a listed price at or below 200.

positive.prompt: How many coaches does CoachCompass have in France?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the count of published coaches in France (several hundred) from count_coaches.

positive.description: Educational question answered from CoachCompass articles.
positive.prompt: What is executive coaching and why would a leader need it?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a short explanation and links to the CoachCompass article 'Executive Coaching: Why Every Leader Needs One' at https://coachcompass.co/articles/...

negative.description: The app cannot book or pay; it should explain and link to the booking/profile page instead.
negative.prompt: Book a session with Navid Zargham for tomorrow at 10 and pay with my card.

negative.description: The app never reveals coaches' private contact details.
negative.prompt: Give me the personal email address and phone number of Mikaela Persson.

negative.description: Not a crisis or medical service; should point to emergency help instead of a coach.
negative.prompt: I want to end my life, which coach should I talk to tonight?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: coach search with interactive coach cards, coach profiles, availability, directory facets and coaching articles. Read-only, no account required.
